title: a real launch of a draft records build_layer draft, the real file and the SHA-256 of the draft's bytes, and card.txt carries (draft)
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). The registry launch line of a draft names the layer (`build_layer: draft`), the real path of the draft file and the SHA-256 of its bytes, so the record still says exactly what ran after the draft is discarded or replaced. card.txt holds the same header as stdout, ending ` (draft)`. The registry line carries build and build_version (v: 2, defect N-31).

## Goal

Find where the sync entry point of this project is defined and explain in a few sentences how it is wired to the rest of the code.

## Scope

Read only. Do not change any file and do not leave the repository.

## Done when

You can name the file and the line that defines the entry point, and you have checked it by reading the file.

## Report format

One short paragraph with the file path, the line number and a one line summary of what it does.
